date.description: The invoice's date. Left out, the organisation's today.

expenses.description: The costs to bill. Left out, all of those in the project's currency.

gst_code.description: The GST code of the invoice's lines. Left out, SR, standard-rated; choose OS or ZR where it applies [verify with the tax agent].

milestone_id.description: For a fixed-fee project, an accepted milestone to bill; for a retainer, a period to bill. The invoice then has that one line, at its amount, and bills nothing else.

revenue_account_id.description: The revenue account the invoice's lines earn.

time_entry_ids.description: The priced time entries to bill. Left out, all of them.

items.description: A time entry's ID (a row of getProjectUnbilled).
